events.title: Astoaria Steam Next Fest Update
events.summary: BIG NEWS! Astoaria is joining Steam Next Fest (October 19–26), and this is a big update to the demo. We've spent these past months adding new systems, reworking old ones and polishing everything we could. Here's the full list.
